The '''2025 All-Pro teams''' were named by the [[Associated Press]] (AP),<ref name="APTeam">{{cite web |title=2025 NFL All-Pro Team: See who made the roster|url=https://apnews.com/article/nfl-all-pro-2025-76fbd57c87e524c320e1194d860b61b3 |website=AP News |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=10 January 2026 |access-date=10 January 2026}}</ref> [[Pro Football Writers of America]] (PFWA),<ref name="PFWATeam">{{cite web |url=https://www.profootballwriters.org/2026/01/19/pfwa-2025-all-nfl-all-afc-and-all-nfc-teams-announced/ |title=PFWA 2025 All-NFL, All-AFC and All-NFC teams announced |website=Pro Football Writers Association |date=January 19, 2026 |access-date=January 19, 2026}}</ref> and ''[[The Sporting News]]'' (TSN)<ref name="TSNTeam">{{Cite web |last=Iyer |first=Vinnie |date=January 29, 2026 |title=NFL All-Pro Team: How NFL head coaches voted for Sporting News' roster in 2025 |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nfl/news/nfl-all-pro-team-2025-sporting-news/b69c0290bd156ec492c9c93b |access-date=January 30, 2026 |website=The Sporting News}}</ref> for performance in the [[2025 NFL season]]. Any player selected to any of the teams can be described as an "All-Pro." The AP team, with first-team and second-team selections, was chosen by a national panel of fifty NFL writers and broadcasters. ''The Sporting News'' All-Pro team was voted on by NFL players and executives. The PFWA All-NFL team is selected by its more than 300 national members who are accredited media members covering the NFL.

For the 2025 vote, the AP added a new "all purpose" position. Similar to the "[[Offensive backfield|flex]]" position voted on from [[2016 All-Pro Team|2016]] to [[2019 All-Pro Team|2019]], the "all-purpose" selection can be a running back, fullback, wide receiver, or tight end.<ref name="USAToday">{{cite web |last1=Ostly |first1=Ayrton |last2=Axson |first2=Scooby |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2026/01/10/nfl-all-pro-teams-2025/88092124007/ |title=NFL All-Pro teams revealed: These players defined the 2025 season |work=[[USA Today]] |date=January 10, 2026 |access-date=January 10, 2026}}</ref>

For this season's AP ballot, [[Los Angeles Rams]] wide receiver [[Puka Nacua]], [[Seattle Seahawks]] wide receiver [[Jaxon Smith-Njigba]], and [[Cleveland Browns]] edge rusher [[Myles Garrett]] were unanimous selections, receiving all 50 first-place votes at their respective positions.<ref name="USAToday" />

==Key==
*AP = Associated Press first-team All-Pro
*AP-2 = Associated Press second-team All-Pro
<!--*AP-t = Tied for first-team All-Pro in the AP vote-->
*AP-2t = Tied for second-team All-Pro in the AP vote
*PFWA = Pro Football Writers Association All-NFL
*TSN = ''The Sporting News'' All-Pro
<!--*TSN-t = Tied for All-Pro in the TSN vote-->

==Position differences==
PFWA and TSN do not separate the tackles and guards into more specific positions as the AP does, nor do they select an all-purpose player on offense. Additionally, PFWA and TSN formally select defensive ends as opposed to edge rushers, while PFWA selects outside linebackers separately from middle linebackers.
